24|def _valid_evidence_entry(ev):
25|    """True when one evidence dict has a known kind and string-ish fields."""
26|    kind = ev.get("kind")
27|    if kind is not None and kind not in (
28|        "file",
29|        "commit",
30|        "test",
31|        "observation",
32|        "user_input",
33|        "external",
34|        "source",
35|    ):
36|        return False
37|    for field in ("source_uri", "source_label"):
38|        value = ev.get(field)
39|        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, str):
40|            return False
41|    return True

44|def _import_item_summary(item):
45|    """Validate one import item without mutating the store."""
46|    if not isinstance(item, dict):
47|        return None, "invalid_item"
48|    summary = item.get("summary")
49|    if not isinstance(summary, str) or not summary.strip():
50|        return None, "empty_summary"
51|    evidence = item.get("evidence") or []
52|    if not isinstance(evidence, list) or any(
53|        not isinstance(ev, dict) for ev in evidence
54|    ):
55|        return None, "invalid_evidence"
56|    for ev in evidence:
57|        if not _valid_evidence_entry(ev):
58|            return None, "invalid_evidence"
59|    return summary, None

62|def _claim_already_present(conn, project_id, claim_fp, scope="project", agent_id=None):
63|    """Check current non-rejected memories using the indexed claim fingerprint."""
64|    if scope not in ("project", "private"):
65|        raise MemCoreError(f"invalid scope: {scope}")
66|    sql = (
67|        "SELECT 1 FROM memory m "
68|        "WHERE m.project_id=? AND m.scope=? AND m.claim_fingerprint=? "
69|        "AND m.lifecycle != 'rejected' "
70|    )
71|    args = [project_id, scope, claim_fp]
72|    if scope == "private":
73|        if not agent_id:
74|            raise MemCoreError("agent_id is required when planning private import")
75|        sql += "AND m.owner_agent_id=? "
76|        args.append(agent_id)
77|    if conn.execute(sql + "LIMIT 1", args).fetchone():
78|        return True
79|
80|    legacy_sql = (
81|        "SELECT v.content FROM memory m "
82|        "JOIN memory_version v ON v.id=m.current_version_id AND v.memory_id=m.id "
83|        "WHERE m.project_id=? AND m.scope=? AND m.claim_fingerprint IS NULL "
84|        "AND m.lifecycle != 'rejected' "
85|    )
86|    legacy_args = [project_id, scope]
87|    if scope == "private":
88|        legacy_sql += "AND m.owner_agent_id=? "
89|        legacy_args.append(agent_id)
90|    return any(
91|        fingerprint(content) == claim_fp
92|        for (content,) in conn.execute(legacy_sql, legacy_args)
93|    )

96|def _import_idempotency_key(project_id, claim_fp, scope="project", agent_id=None):
97|    if scope == "project":
98|        return f"import:{project_id}:{claim_fp}"
99|    if scope == "private":
100|        if not agent_id:
101|            raise MemCoreError("agent_id is required for private import idempotency")
102|        return f"import:{project_id}:private:{agent_id}:{claim_fp}"
103|    raise MemCoreError(f"invalid scope: {scope}")

106|def _classify_import_item(conn, item, project_id, scope, agent_id, seen):
107|    """Classify one import item read-only: (fingerprint, reason_or_None)."""
108|    summary, reason = _import_item_summary(item)
109|    fp = fingerprint(summary) if summary is not None else None
110|    if reason is None and fp in seen:
111|        reason = "duplicate_input"
112|    if reason is None:
113|        ikey = _import_idempotency_key(
114|            project_id, fp, scope=scope, agent_id=agent_id
115|        )
116|        if conn.execute(
117|            "SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_key WHERE key=?", (ikey,)
118|        ).fetchone():
119|            reason = "already_imported"
120|        elif _tombstone_active(conn, fp, project_id, scope=scope, agent_id=agent_id):
121|            reason = "tombstone_blocked"
122|        elif _claim_already_present(
123|            conn, project_id, fp, scope=scope, agent_id=agent_id
124|        ):
125|            reason = "already_present"
126|    return fp, reason

129|def plan_import(conn, items, project_id, scope="project", agent_id=None):
130|    """Read-only import preview: classify every item and perform zero writes."""
131|    if not isinstance(items, list):
132|        raise MemCoreError("items must be a list")
133|    if scope not in ("project", "private"):
134|        raise MemCoreError(f"invalid scope: {scope}")
135|    if scope == "private" and not agent_id:
136|        raise MemCoreError("agent_id is required when planning private import")
137|    plan = {
138|        "total": len(items),
139|        "would_add": 0,
140|        "skipped": 0,
141|        "reasons": {},
142|        "items": [],
143|    }
144|    seen = set()
145|    for index, item in enumerate(items):
146|        fp, reason = _classify_import_item(
147|            conn, item, project_id, scope, agent_id, seen
148|        )
149|        if reason is None:
150|            seen.add(fp)
151|            plan["would_add"] += 1
152|            status = "would_add"
153|        else:
154|            if reason == "already_imported" and fp is not None:
155|                seen.add(fp)
156|            plan["skipped"] += 1
157|            plan["reasons"][reason] = plan["reasons"].get(reason, 0) + 1
158|            status = reason
159|        plan["items"].append(
160|            {"index": index, "status": status, "fingerprint": fp}
161|        )
162|    return plan

173|def _insert_import_evidence(conn, version_id, ev):
174|    """Insert one evidence row plus its support link for an imported version."""
175|    raw_kind = ev.get("kind")
176|    kind = "external" if raw_kind in (None, "source") else raw_kind
177|    metadata = {"original_kind": raw_kind} if raw_kind == "source" else {}
178|    ev_id = _new_id("ev")
179|    conn.execute(
180|        "INSERT INTO evidence (id, kind, source_uri, source_label, metadata, captured_at) "
181|        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
182|        (
183|            ev_id,
184|            kind,
185|            ev.get("source_uri"),
186|            ev.get("source_label"),
187|            json.dumps(metadata),
188|            _now(),
189|        ),
190|    )
191|    conn.execute(
192|        "INSERT INTO evidence_link (evidence_id, memory_version_id, relation, created_at) "
193|        "VALUES (?, ?, 'supports', ?)",
194|        (ev_id, version_id, _now()),
195|    )

198|def _import_one_item(conn, item, summary, fp, project_id, agent_id, scope):
199|    """Create one imported memory + its evidence inside the caller's savepoint."""
200|    ikey = _import_idempotency_key(
201|        project_id, fp, scope=scope, agent_id=agent_id
202|    )
203|    already = conn.execute(
204|        "SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_key WHERE key = ?", (ikey,)
205|    ).fetchone()
206|    if already:
207|        raise _SkipImport(fp)
208|    if _tombstone_active(
209|        conn, fp, project_id, scope=scope, agent_id=agent_id
210|    ):
211|        raise _SkipImport(fp)
212|    if _claim_already_present(
213|        conn, project_id, fp, scope=scope, agent_id=agent_id
214|    ):
215|        raise _SkipImport(fp)
216|    raw_type = item.get("type")
217|    mem_type = (
218|        raw_type.strip()
219|        if isinstance(raw_type, str) and raw_type.strip()
220|        else "fact"
221|    )
222|    mem_id, ver_id = create_memory(
223|        conn,
224|        project_id,
225|        agent_id,
226|        summary,
227|        scope=scope,
228|        memory_type=mem_type,
229|        idempotency_key=ikey,
230|        _manage_transaction=False,
231|    )
232|    for ev in item.get("evidence") or []:
233|        _insert_import_evidence(conn, ver_id, ev)
234|    return mem_id, ver_id

237|def import_memories(
238|    conn, items, project_id, agent_id, scope="project", batch_size=100
239|):
240|    """Bulk import candidate memories with per-item atomicity."""
241|    if not isinstance(items, list):
242|        raise MemCoreError("items must be a list")
243|    if scope not in ("project", "private"):
244|        raise MemCoreError(f"invalid scope: {scope}")
245|    if scope == "private" and not agent_id:
246|        raise MemCoreError("agent_id is required when importing private memories")
247|    added, skipped, created = 0, 0, []
248|    seen = set()
249|    in_batch = 0
250|    with store.write_tx(conn):
251|        for item in items:
252|            summary, invalid_reason = _import_item_summary(item)
253|            if invalid_reason is not None:
254|                skipped += 1
255|                continue
256|            fp = fingerprint(summary)
257|            if fp in seen:
258|                skipped += 1
259|                continue
260|            try:
261|                with store._savepoint(conn, "item_sp"):
262|                    mem_id, ver_id = _import_one_item(
263|                        conn, item, summary, fp, project_id, agent_id, scope
264|                    )
265|            except _SkipImport as skip:
266|                if skip.fingerprint:
267|                    seen.add(skip.fingerprint)
268|                skipped += 1
269|                continue
270|            except (TombstoneBlocked, PermissionDenied, MemCoreError):
271|                skipped += 1
272|                continue
273|            seen.add(fp)
274|            added += 1
275|            created.append((mem_id, ver_id))
276|            in_batch += 1
277|            if batch_size and in_batch >= batch_size:
278|                conn.execute("COMMIT")
279|                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
280|                in_batch = 0
281|    return {"added": added, "skipped": skipped, "created": created}
